Skill.title: Add Kiosk Slides to your AI
Skill.intro: Set it up once. Then ask your AI for a presentation and get a file back that opens and presents in any browser.

claudeCode.name: Claude Code
claudeCode.where: Paste each line into Claude Code and press Enter.
claudeCode.note: It updates itself when a new version comes out.
claudeCode.ask: /kiosk-slides Make a 6-slide presentation about our quarterly results

codex.name: Codex
codex.where: Paste each line into your terminal and press Enter.
codex.note: It updates itself when a new version comes out.
codex.ask: Use kiosk-slides to make a 6-slide presentation about our quarterly results

copilot.name: Copilot
copilot.where: Paste the first two lines into your terminal and press Enter after each. In VS Code, run Chat: Install Plugin From Source and paste the last line.
copilot.note: It updates itself when a new version comes out.
copilot.ask: Use kiosk-slides to make a 6-slide presentation about our quarterly results

gemini.name: Gemini CLI
gemini.where: Paste this into your terminal and press Enter.
gemini.note: Run it again to get a new version.
gemini.ask: Use kiosk-slides to make a 6-slide presentation about our quarterly results

other.name: Other apps
other.where: For Cursor, OpenCode, Windsurf, Amp and others. Paste this into a terminal in your project folder and press Enter.
other.note: Run the same line with update instead of add to get a new version.
other.ask: Use kiosk-slides to make a 6-slide presentation about our quarterly results

Skill.tryNote: Your AI uses Kiosk Slides only when you name it like this.

Settings.title: Presentation settings
Settings.toneHelp: Lights the background and highlighted heading words, in a shade made for this theme.
Settings.brandHelp: Shown in the corner of every slide.
Settings.creditHelp: Adds “Made with Kiosk Slides” to the end of downloads and to share links. Never on a slide.

gentle.name: Gentle
gentle.help: A soft rise and fade. Calm enough for any room.

fade.name: Crossfade
fade.help: A clean crossfade. Smooth when screen sharing on a good connection.

slide.name: Slide
slide.help: Slides glide sideways in the direction you move.

Settings.shareSafeActive: Screen-share safe is on, so every transition becomes a quick flat fade.
Settings.shareSafeHelp: Quick flat fades with no movement, blur or glow. Stays crisp when screen sharing and on meeting-room TVs.

Help.title: Getting your slides in
Help.intro: The quickest way is to let AI write your slides. Use Ask AI here, or any AI chat you like.
Help.promptBody: Copy this prompt into your AI chat and say what your talk is about. Paste its answer anywhere on this page.

heading.rule: The big line on each slide. One per slide, kept short. Press Enter to carry it onto a second line.

highlight.rule: Highlights the key words in a heading.

text.rule: A sentence or two under the heading, after an empty line.

extras.rule: A list, table, picture, chart or number. One per slide. AI adds these for you.

Help.skillTitle: Make slides right inside your AI
Help.skillBody: Add Kiosk Slides to your AI once. Then ask it for a presentation by name.

Shortcuts.title: Make yourself at home.
Shortcuts.intro: Everything you need. Nothing in the way.

tidy.name: Clean up the text while editing

continueList.name: Continue a list; press again on an empty item to end it

boldItalic.name: Make the selected words bold or italic

leaveEditor.name: Leave the text box with the keyboard

undo.name: Undo a slide change, AI change or paste

addSlide.name: Add a slide after the selected one

moveSlide.name: Move the selected slide in the slide list, or drag it

deleteSlide.name: Delete the selected slide in the slide list

Shortcuts.note: Scroll over the canvas to move one slide at a time. Click the presentation or navigate to pause autoplay. Presentations are saved in this browser; switch or create them from the menu at the top.

blank.heading: Start with **one clear idea**
blank.body: Paste slides from any AI, or press Ask AI.

connect.title: Write slides with your ChatGPT plan.
connect.intro: Describe your talk and ChatGPT writes the slides for you. Your sign-in stays on this computer.
connect.noPlanUsage: You’re signed in as {email}, but ChatGPT plan usage wasn’t allowed. Connect again and allow it to write slides.
connect.fineprint: Eligible AI requests use your ChatGPT plan, not a Kiosk Slides subscription. Kiosk Slides doesn’t charge for them. You can manage usage in ChatGPT settings.

welcome.title: You’re connected to ChatGPT
welcome.body: AI requests in Kiosk Slides now use your ChatGPT plan. Kiosk Slides doesn’t charge for them, and your plan’s usage limits apply.

empty.title: What are you presenting?
empty.body: ChatGPT writes the slides and saves them as a presentation. Ask for changes any time.

composer.label: Message ChatGPT
composer.first: What is your presentation about, and who is it for?

local.title: Use any AI chat to write your slides.
local.body: Copy the prompt, paste it into your AI chat, and say what your talk is about. Then paste its answer anywhere on this page.
local.runHere: Chat with your ChatGPT plan right here
local.privacy: Your sign-in stays on your computer and never reaches this website.
local.then: Then open {url} and choose Ask AI.
local.addSkill: Or add Kiosk Slides to your AI

offline.title: Ask AI needs a connection
offline.body: Everything else works offline: your presentations are saved on this device, and you can edit, present and download them.

errors.noModels: No ChatGPT models are available for this account.
errors.signOutUnconfirmed: Signed out here, but ChatGPT didn’t confirm it. You can also disconnect Kiosk Slides in ChatGPT settings.
errors.offline: Ask AI needs a connection. Check the internet and try again.

Server.hostedOnly: ChatGPT plan usage works only when you run Kiosk Slides on your own computer.
Server.openLocally: Open Kiosk Slides at http://127.0.0.1 on your own computer to use your ChatGPT plan.
Server.wrongOrigin: This request must come from the Kiosk Slides page.
Server.tooLong: This conversation is too long. Start a new chat.
Server.badMessage: Each message needs a role and text under {max, number} characters.
Server.badOrder: The conversation must start and end with a user message.
Server.presentationTooLarge: The current presentation is too large to send.
Server.stillBroken: The slides still have a problem after {attempts, plural, one {# try} other {# tries}}: {error}
Server.generic: Something went wrong while writing your slides.

signIn.expired: This sign-in link expired. Try connecting again.
signIn.clientMismatch: ChatGPT returned a different app registration. Try again.
signIn.registrationIncomplete: ChatGPT did not finish registering Kiosk Slides. Try again.
signIn.missingCode: ChatGPT sign-in returned no code. Try again.
signIn.notCompleted: ChatGPT sign-in could not be completed. Try again.
signIn.invalidClient: Kiosk Slides’ ChatGPT registration is invalid. Disconnect and connect again.
signIn.invalidToken: ChatGPT sign-in could not be verified. Try again.

session.planDisabled: ChatGPT plan usage isn’t enabled for this sign-in. Disconnect and connect again to allow it.
session.expired: Your ChatGPT session expired. Connect again.

response.incomplete: The reply was cut off before it finished. Try a shorter request.
response.interrupted: The connection to ChatGPT ended early. Try again.
response.unauthorized: ChatGPT did not accept this sign-in. Disconnect and connect again.
response.unavailable: ChatGPT plan usage is unavailable right now. Try again shortly.
response.unknown: ChatGPT could not complete this request.

codes.subscription_sharing_user_not_eligible: ChatGPT plan usage isn’t available for this account or workspace.
codes.subscription_sharing_usage_limit_exceede: You’ve reached a ChatGPT plan usage limit. Check your usage in ChatGPT settings.
codes.subscription_sharing_usage_unavailable: ChatGPT usage couldn’t be checked right now. Try again shortly.
codes.subscription_sharing_unsupported_capabil: This request uses a feature that isn’t supported with ChatGPT plan usage.
codes.subscription_sharing_route_not_supported: This request type isn’t supported with ChatGPT plan usage.
codes.subscription_sharing_invalid_user: Your ChatGPT sign-in needs to be renewed. Disconnect and connect again.
codes.subscription_sharing_user_unavailable: ChatGPT account information is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
codes.chatpass_v2_scope_not_authorized: Kiosk Slides isn’t authorized for this operation.
codes.chatpass_v2_invalid_authorization_contex: Kiosk Slides isn’t authorized for this operation.
